name: Media License
author: Octavius.rocks

sections.description: Extend your media files with license information. Customizable and themable.
sections.installation:
1. Upload media-license.zip to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Extract the Plugin to a media-license Folder
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  4. Now you can add creative common license and much more to you media files
sections.faq:
Can I extend the licenses?

Yes you can with the filter function “media_license_add_fields”.
